report_comment.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription. NFATC2 encodes a nuclear-factor-of-activated-T-cells transcription factor. EWSR1::NFATC2 joins EWSR1 to NFATC2 and is associated with an EWSR1::non-ETS mesenchymal tumor group, molecularly distinct from conventional Ewing sarcoma.
